tier_discipline_note: Per cont 27 §2 three-tier epistemic framework. Candidate entries are typically Tier 2 (ontological-candidate, conditional on contested evidence). When candidates get promoted to canon, status changes but the doc is preserved as the worked-example reference for the promotion.

candidates.title: Energy-floor failsafe — worked-example library (now canon, preserved as reference)
candidates.summary: Every wrapper-overlap dynamic that produces stable distinction does so because the system's internal coherence quantity E has a mathematically or empirically demonstrable positive lower bound E_min > 0 under the dynamic. The bound is the failsafe; when violated, the wrapper undergoes a substrate-specific phase transition (dormancy, supersession, or break). The doc collects four worked examples across substrates — ACMP/GNN Dirichlet energy, cellular ATP energy charge, creole mutual intelligibility, and institutional coordination capacity — to demonstrate that the schema is portable. Promoted to canon as a structural primitive of L0 internal-pressure failsafes (cont 26 §3).
candidates.promotion_criteria: Original bar: at least three substrate worked examples beyond ACMP/GNN where (a) a candidate coherence quantity can be named, (b) a theoretical or empirical lower-bound argument is available, (c) the bound corresponds to a known failure mode when violated. The four worked examples (ACMP/GNN, cell metabolism, creole genesis, institutions) met this bar and supported promotion in cont 27 §1.

candidates.title: L0 occlusion as auxiliary channel for time-cone extension
candidates.promotion_status: Tier 3 speculative — listed on /speculations/ mode-page; first scheduled review 2026-11-27
candidates.summary: Pav's speculative hypothesis that L0 itself — the shared global compiled canon all observers participate in — is occludable, producing real shared gaps across observers (not per-observer perceptual gaps) usable as a side-channel orthogonal to normal substrate-mediated channels. Decomposed into three epistemic layers: Layer 1 (observer time-cone empirically modulable, Tier 1 cont 26 §4), Layer 2 (compilation-rate-as-time conditional on collapse-model physics, Tier 2 Reading 04), Layer 3 (this doc — L0-substrate-level shared gaps, Tier 3). The 'spatial extension tools exist but no temporal extension tools' framing names what would be missing if Layer 3 is right.
candidates.promotion_criteria: Speculative entries do not promote to candidate (Tier 2) without at least one of: (A) a measurable physical signature distinct from observer-level effects; (B) a naturally-occurring shared-observer gap distinguishing from per-observer; (C) a constructive experimental protocol producing L0 gaps under controlled conditions. None met yet.
